posts.title: What lies ahead
posts.description: I've been running a game intermittently over the past 4/5 months. We've had a total of four sessions, one in Cairn and the others in my own brand of B/X / OSE. I've had fun, but we haven't quite hit our stride. Now, I'm wondering if we even should! What I want I want to run a weekly campaign for a year. posts.title: Sunrise
posts.description: In the tradition of many great, ultimately broken promises, I wish to start this blog anew with my own. We'll see how I fare: Over the next twelve months, I will make at least one fortnightly post on this blog. I've got a lot of thoughts about games! In the worst case, my hobby acquires a healthy balance of both reading and writing.
